title: RuntimeDeliver
description: A message has pending deliveries for a runtime. Published on agenthub.rt.<runtime_id>.deliver, once per message and runtime, to wake that runtime's connection. Carries ids only: the connection loads the deliveries and the message before pushing them.

sequence_number.description: The message's position in its conversation.

delivery_ids.description: The message_deliveries rows for this runtime: one per agent of the runtime in the conversation, plus one if the runtime takes part itself.
